g.text: Most of the gain survives when the patch comes from another date

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: each arm's mean quantile score minus GAM-K's (points of capacity), five decision substations, leads 0.5 to 168 hours, outside switching events. Line: 99% interval from resampling whole calendar months. Arms reading the wrong date's weather (ENC-cpt) still gain, so part of the gain recalibrates GAM-K's quantiles and carries no information from the weather of that day.'
text.tspan: Dot: each arm's mean quantile score minus GAM-K's (points of capacity), five decision
substations, leads 0.5 to 168 hours, outside switching events. Line: 99% interval from
resampling whole calendar months. Arms reading the wrong date's weather (ENC-cpt) still gain,
so part of the gain recalibrates GAM-K's quantiles and carries no information from the weather
